title: DetectRequest
description: The 'request' part of a 'detect-holds@2' job (runner protocol 1.2): jobs/detect-holds/holds-job plus the model, which is fetched by hash (GET /api/runners/models/{sha256}) instead of travelling in the bundle. The result is jobs/detect-holds/holds-result, unchanged: camera image name = the photo part's file name.

name.description: Display name; detections are stored under 'yolo-runner:<first 12 of sha256>'.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the ONNX model. A runner whose cached model has another hash fetches this one.
